programs.title: Building Off the Grid
programs.desc: Builder Phil Parr heads to the wilderness of northern Colorado to build the ultimate off-grid tent; far beyond simple nylon and poles, this lavish tent has a custom fabricated wooden frame, canvas shell and 650-square-feet of livable elegance.

programs.title: Building Off the Grid
programs.desc: A couple constructs an upcycled off-grid homestead deep in the sprawling South Carolina islands; plans for the catamaran-style home include a luxury yacht aesthetic, but the couple must build during hurricane season to meet their deadline.

programs.title: Building Off the Grid
programs.desc: Novice builder Danny Clark attempts to construct a 600-square-foot stone cabin in Vermont's White River Valley; the home is sure to be a true work of art, but his inexperience, the harsh winter and the unusual architecture push him to his limits.

programs.title: Building Off the Grid
programs.desc: Peter and Ashley Jensen build a sustainable straw-bale panel house in New York's Hudson Valley -- the first of its kind in the United States; with only three months to work, they race to finish before winter sets in.

programs.title: Building Outside the Lines
programs.sub_title: Historic Granary Becomes a Goat Milk Goods Haven
programs.desc: Cappie and Alex relocate and restore a 120-year-old granary, transforming it into a rustic-yet-functional retail space for goat milk-based products -- honoring their clients' expanding farm with personal touches and plenty of space to grow.

programs.title: Building Outside the Lines
programs.sub_title: From Concrete Drum to Hot Tub Haven
programs.desc: Empty-nesters crave a magical place to reconnect -- so Cappie and Alex build a hot tub haven from a concrete drum base, complete with a custom burner, wraparound deck, and warm, glowing lights.
